title: Momentum Guest Lecture 2027
objectives: Showcase student talent to the wider campus
resources: Sponsor-provided prizes, registration desk and photography team
risks: Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 120 attendees for this Guest Lecture, in line with turnout at our previous Guest Lecture events.
The requested budget of INR 16,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Guest Lecture.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
